name: hw-arrow
title: Hand-Drawn Arrow
description: A hand-drawn arrow that draws on and boils, rising from below-left to one phrase: straight, gentle or swoop bend, plain, soft, sharp or spray line. Ships the hw-boil and hw-arrow helpers for hosts that point at their own content.

controls.name: arrowStyle
controls.drives: curve bend pose over the seeded wobble math (bend constant + both cubic control points)

controls.name: strokeType
controls.drives: curve texture via hwStrokeApply (soft blur / dry-marker dasharray on a mask clone / seeded deterministic spray dots); the head stays plain

controls.name: boil
controls.drives: boil amp/rot as authored pairs over the family-locked frameDrop 3; seed locked
